notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has a power of five or greater.Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
